labels.text: Croatia adopts the euro and joins the Schengen Area, becoming the 20th member state of the Eurozone and the 27th member of the Schengen Area. This is the first enlargement of the Eurozone since Lithuania's entry in 2015, and the first enlargement of the Schengen Area since Liechtenstein's entry in 2011.
2024 Croatian parliamentary election: Incumbent Prime Minister Andrej Plenković's Croatian Democratic Union coalition wins a plurality of seats.
2024–25 Croatian presidential election: Zoran Milanović is re-elected for a second term.
The 2025 World Men's Handball Championship is held in Croatia, Denmark and Norway, and is won by Denmark.
Croatia completes the process of joining the European Economic Area.
